scheme_contracts.execution_notes: Australia's largest DURATION BESS at 8-hour (2,400 MWh vs prior 1,200 MWh spec). EPBC 'not controlled action' Aug/Sep 2025. Construction target 2026, 18-month build. No EPC/FC news surfaced Jul 2026. Third of Edify's T4 non-NSW wins — Guthrie's Gap + Smoky Creek both reached FC 20 May 2026 (Rio Tinto offtake); Nowingi is the outlier still pre-FC.

eis_specs.connection_augmentation: Existing 220 kV AusNet Red Cliffs to Horsham overhead transmission line.
eis_specs.notes: Solar 300 MWac. BESS 300 MW / 2400 MWh (8.0h duration). Regime: EPBC. Edify Energy. Determined 'not a controlled action' under EPBC Act (Sep 2025). 300 MW (360 MWp) solar + 300 MW/2,400 MWh 8-hour BESS on 637 ha, ~47 km south of Mildura. Would be largest-duration BESS in Australia at start-up. Construction target 2026. AgriPV design. AEMO KCI V00164. DC-coupled solar+BESS hybrid with grid-forming inverters. Would be Australia's largest-duration BESS (8 hr) at start-up. 360 MWp DC solar, ~637 ha, AgriPV design. DC-coupled solar+BESS hybrid with grid-forming inverters. operational_notes: Australia's largest duration BESS — 8-hour: 300 MW / 2,400 MWh (vs prior AURES 1,200 MWh spec). EPBC 'not controlled action' Aug/Sep 2025. Construction target 2026 (18-month build, ~250 jobs). No EPC or FC news surfaced Jul 2026. Pre-FID at ~10 months post-award. Same Edify (La Caisse-owned) proponent as Guthrie's Gap + Smoky Creek (which reached FC 20 May 2026) — Nowingi is the third of Edify's T4 non-NSW wins, still pre-FC as of Jul 2026.
